meta.title: 亚麻苎麻汉麻什么区别？怎么选？怎么养护？
meta.title_en: Linen, Ramie, and Hemp: How to Choose and Care

scenes.context: 亚麻、苎麻、汉麻什么区别？怎么选？以及该怎么养护？
sentences: 亚麻苎麻汉麻有什么区别。
What's the difference between linen, ramie, and hemp?
linen / ramie / hemp（亚麻 / 苎麻 / 汉麻）
How to choose and how to care for them.
paraphrase: 用linen / ramie / hemp换一种说法
What's the difference between linen, ramie, and hemp?
How to choose and how to care for them.
scenes.speak: What's the difference between linen, ramie, and hemp? How to choose and how to care for them.

scenes.context: 亚麻85%产自法国比利时荷兰等，主要依赖进口，所以价格偏高。
scenes.speak: Linen is mostly imported. That's why it costs more.

scenes.context: 亚麻纤维有明显竹节纹理，第一次穿稍硬挺，敏感肌可能有点扎，但越洗越柔软。
sentences: 亚麻有明显的竹节纹理。
Linen has a distinct slub texture.
It gets softer with every wash.
paraphrase: Linen has a distinct slub texture.
It gets softer with every wash.
scenes.speak: Linen has a distinct slub texture. It gets softer with every wash.

scenes.context: 亚麻缩水率是所有麻类里最高的，买亚麻衣服买大不买小，或买做过洗水工艺处理的。
sentences: Linen shrinks the most of all hemp fabrics.
paraphrase: Linen shrinks the most of all hemp fabrics.
scenes.speak: Linen shrinks the most of all hemp fabrics. Size up rather than down.

scenes.context: 苎麻主要产自中国，产量大加工容易，是所有麻类里最便宜的；纤维最细最长，吸湿散热最好、缩水率最低。
sentences: 苎麻是所有麻里最便宜的。
Ramie is the cheapest of the three.
纤维最细，吸湿散热最好。
Its fibers are finest, with the best breathability.
paraphrase: Ramie is the cheapest of the three.
Its fibers are finest, with the best breathability.
scenes.speak: Ramie is the cheapest of the three. Its fibers are finest, with the best breathability.

scenes.context: 纤维又细又长反而更硬挺，是所有麻里上身穿扎感最强的。
sentences: Fine long fibers are actually stiffer.
It feels the prickliest against the skin.
paraphrase: Fine long fibers are actually stiffer.
It feels the prickliest against the skin.
scenes.speak: Fine long fibers are actually stiffer. It feels the prickliest against the skin.

scenes.context: 汉麻80%产自中国黑龙江，产量少加工难所以最贵；单纤维短且头部钝圆，上身舒适度和抗皱性最好。
sentences: 汉麻是所有麻里最贵的。
Hemp is the priciest of all.
It's the most comfortable to wear.
paraphrase: Hemp is the priciest of all.
It's the most comfortable to wear.
scenes.speak: Hemp is the priciest of all. It's the most comfortable to wear.

scenes.context: 第一次尝试选亚麻（性价比最高）；重视舒适度选汉麻；重视透气防晒选苎麻。洗护就简单过下水、通风晾干、卷起来存放。
sentences: Start with linen for the best value.
Air dry and store it rolled up.
paraphrase: Start with linen for the best value.
Air dry and store it rolled up.
scenes.speak: Start with linen for the best value. Air dry and store it rolled up.

practice: 亚麻缩水率最高，怎么说？

Hemp is the most comfortable to wear.
买亚麻衣服要买大不买小。
Size up rather than down when buying linen.
pitfalls: 第一次买麻直接买汉麻
汉麻最贵，亚麻性价比最高
亚麻缩水率是所有麻里最高的
以为苎麻纤维细就柔软
